description: Room take lifecycle: begin, append, complete, complete idle, delete.

preconditions: A Pending room take made by the actor (the Secretary) in an InPerson meeting that is InProgress.
Part size 320,000 bytes; upload limit 300 MB.
The take is empty.
cases.inputs: part 1; 320,000 bytes starting with a valid 44-byte 16 kHz mono 16-bit WAV header; length 320,000; final false.
cases.return: Success (204) with the take id: file written at offset 0, ByteSize 320,000, DurationMs 9,998.

preconditions: A Pending room take made by the actor (the Secretary) in an InPerson meeting that is InProgress.
Part size 320,000 bytes; upload limit 300 MB.
ByteSize is 320,000 (part 1 stored).
cases.inputs: part 2; 320,000 bytes of PCM; length 320,000; final false.
cases.return: Success: written at offset 320,000; ByteSize 640,000; DurationMs 19,998.

preconditions: A Pending room take made by the actor (the Secretary) in an InPerson meeting that is InProgress.
Part size 320,000 bytes; upload limit 300 MB.
ByteSize is 640,000.
cases.inputs: part 2 again with the same 320,000 bytes.
cases.return: Success; the part is overwritten in place, ByteSize stays 640,000.

preconditions: A Pending room take made by the actor (the Secretary) in an InPerson meeting that is InProgress.
Part size 320,000 bytes; upload limit 300 MB.
ByteSize is 640,000.
cases.inputs: part 3 as the final part with 100,000 bytes.
cases.return: Success: written at offset 640,000, the file is cut to 740,000 bytes, ByteSize 740,000, DurationMs 23,123.

preconditions: A Pending room take made by the actor (the Secretary) in an InPerson meeting that is InProgress.
Part size 320,000 bytes; upload limit 300 MB.
ByteSize is 740,000 after a short final part.
cases.inputs: part 3 as final again with 50,000 bytes.
cases.return: Success; the file is cut at 690,000 and ByteSize becomes 690,000 (a resent final part leaves no tail).

preconditions: A Pending room take made by the actor (the Secretary) in an InPerson meeting that is InProgress.
